tables.title: Effect of low-power modes on the USART
tables.text_helper: Table 132, "Effect of low-power modes on the USART", in section 26.6 (USART in low-power modes) on page 793. Columns: Mode, Description. 3 data row(s). Notes: 1. rows: No effect. USART interrupts cause the device to exit Sleep mode.

The content of the USART registers is kept.
The USART is able to wake up the microcontroller from Stop mode when 
the USART is clocked by an oscillator available in Stop mode.

The USART peripheral is powered down and must be reinitialized after 
exiting Standby mode.
notes: 1. Refer to Section26.4: USART implementation to know if the wake-up from Stop mode is supported for a given peripheral instance. If an instance is not functional in a given Stop mode, it must be disabled before entering this Stop mode.
